stable.title: PlayDeck v0.4.9
stable.summary:
• Proton extras install again. Extra Proton builds (GE-Proton, proton-cachyos, DroidDeck-Proton) downloaded ~350–650 MB and then always failed with a checksum error; the catalog checksums are now read and honored, so installs complete.
• Turnip driver downloads work. Driver downloads from the release catalog failed immediately after refresh; the catalog checksum is now carried through and corrupt partials are deleted before retry.
• Sessions no longer stay awake forever. The "starting Steam" phase could hold the wake lock indefinitely if the activity died before the first frame (bounded to 15 minutes now); stale "Running Update" entries expire after 90 seconds; a failed suspend retries with backoff instead of disabling suspend for the rest of the session.
• Desktop-mode Steam downloads are protected from suspend, like gaming mode.
• Concurrent component downloads. One finished download no longer dismisses the notifications of the downloads still running.
• Store downloads. Closed a pause/cancel race that could let an install run to completion after pausing; the store service no longer lingers as a foreground service after the queue drains; GOG downloads now require HTTP 206 so a bad range response can't silently corrupt an install.
• "Suspend now" works from the notification in every suspend policy, even while the app is visible; background game launches no longer corrupt visibility tracking.
• Smaller UI jank. Progress ticks (percent/stage) no longer recompose the whole launcher screen; the session drawer's game profile only republishes on change.
